thread:
sara_ml: Nightly eval alert — v13b run shows structured-output promptset failing intermittently. 18/200 prompts returned JSON where fields are misaligned (e.g., `steps` moved into `summary`, `code` appears inside `metadata`). Dashboard: https://redwood-internal/evals/board/xyz :warning:
omar_infer: That landed after yesterday's model push + tokenizer split + q4_0 quant. Any correlation with quantization? :thinking:
li_eval: I checked token-level diffs on a few failing examples. Looks like a separator token change; the model emits an extra U+FFFD-like marker between fields sometimes. Not all failures — more frequent on longer outputs and higher seqlen.
jen_ops: Deploy bot shows the rollout was v13b-merge-20260318, with kernel pin q4_0-int8. No autoscale changes. deploy-bot: rollout v13b-merge-20260318 -> 100% at 2026-03-18T22:40Z.
sara_ml: Repro script (quick):
```
# curl reproducer
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWD" \
  -d '{"model":"v13b","prompt":"<structured_output>give summary,steps,code</structured_output>","max_tokens":600}'
```
Bad response (trimmed):
```
{"summary":"High-level overview.\n - step1\n - step2","steps":"","metadata":{"code":"def foo(): pass","notes":"..."}}
```
Note: summary contains steps and code moved into metadata.code sometimes.
omar_infer: Hypothesis: tokenizer split changed a reserved separator token used by our structured-output parser. When quantized kernels hit some attention boundary, the model pushes the delimiter into token stream differently. Could be a new BPE pair introduced.
li_eval: I ran tokenization on the prompt+gold for a failing case: pre-upgrade tokens: [101,234, ... 999]; post-upgrade tokens: [101,234, ... 1001] — there's a new merge at the end of the field marker. Will paste diffs in a sec.
li_eval: Diff snippet: ``
- "<|field_sep|>" -> bytes: 0x1f 0x9
+ "<|field_sep|>" -> bytes: 0x1f 0x9 0x7f
``
jen_ops: Can we quick rollback to v13a for hosted to confirm? That would help isolate model weights vs infra.
sara_ml: Could also be quantization interaction. Can we repro with non-quantized (fp16) version pinned? If fp16 ok, then q4 path is suspect.
jen_ops: I'll schedule a canary with v13b-fp16 in dedicated staging region and run the promptset. Rolling now (small). deploy-bot: started canary v13b-fp16 -> 5% at 2026-03-19T00:10Z.
li_eval: Running nightly subset on canary. Quick check: 50 prompts done, failures: 0 so far. Good sign.
omar_infer: If canary clean, likely q4 quant path. Next steps: 1) reproduce locally with same q4 pipeline; 2) run tokenizer compare tool across vocab merges; 3) add extra assert in structured-output parser to detect when field order deviates and log tokens.
sara_ml: For engineers who pick this up: repro script + one failing example attached to the eval board. Also filing a quick issue: https://redwood-issues/ML/5473 — please tag if you dig in.
jen_ops: If q4 is root cause we should pin hosted back to fp16 for now and re-run offline quantization calibration. I'll wait for confirmation from canary results then escalate.
li_eval: TL;DR: v13b weight+tokenizer change + q4 quant path -> intermittent delimiter insertion -> structured JSON misalignment. Repro with fp16 looks clean.
sara_ml: Nice work. Action items: #1 (li) paste tokenizer diff and exact failing tokens in the issue; #2 (omar) run local q4 repro and capture logits around delimiter positions; #3 (jen) hold rollback/pin plan ready if canary shows regressions at scale.
omar_infer: On it — will post logs in the ticket. :mag:
jen_ops: I set an alert to mute noisy eval flakes but keep critical regression alerts. :white_check_mark:
sara_ml: Thanks all — marking as in-progress. Will update when we have concrete root cause. :rocket:
